prerequisites: Good basic knowledge in Physics, Mathematics I and II

learning_outcomes.text: Students know the basic concepts and the importance of physics in mechanical engineering.
Students understand the most important equations of physics.
Students are able to solve simple technical problems from the field of mechanical engineering using physics methods.

syllabus_topics: Basics: Importance of physics for engineering sciences, methods of physics, SI system, quantities, units, measurement
Mechanics: Kinematics and dynamics of a mass point, Newton's axioms, work, energy, conservation laws of mechanics

Electricity: Charge, electric field, electric field strength, potential, voltage, plate capacitor, current strength, magnetic field, magnetic flux density, Lorentz force, induction law, coil, Ohm's law, Kirchhoff's rules, work and power in DC circuits
Optics: Geometric optics, optical components, light as an electromagnetic wave, refraction and dispersion
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
